cohort: 295 pregnant women with OI identified from the Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project Nationwide Inpatient Sample database between 2003 and 2011
finding: Pregnancies complicated by OI were associated with increased risks of various maternal and fetal complications, including antepartum hemorrhage, placenta abruption, intrauterine growth restriction, congenital malformations, and preterm birth.
mod_finding: Women with OI had a higher rate of cesarean delivery (75%).
